band.label: Our approach
band.big: First we understand your business. Then we *design*.
band.h3: No off-the-shelf packages — a plan built around your goals.
band.p: We analyse your audience, competitors and sales funnel, then put your budget into the channels that deliver the most. Every stage has a clear goal and a way to measure it.

servicesHead.label: Services
servicesHead.heading: *Everything* you need to grow.
servicesHead.text: Stop juggling contractors. One team runs all your digital channels, from strategy to execution.

workbench.label: Why Digiterial
workbench.heading: Looking good isn't enough. Your site has to *sell*.
workbench.text: We test every decision against four questions: is it clear, is it convincing, is it fast, can we measure it?
workbench.p1: Copy and structure that explain why customers should choose you — in the first five seconds.
workbench.p2: Every screen serves one goal: a call, an enquiry or a sale.
workbench.p3: Core Web Vitals, mobile-first code and a search-ready structure.
workbench.p4: GA4, conversion tracking and monthly reports — you see what works, in numbers.

process.label: Process
process.heading: From first call to *results* in 4 steps.
process.text: At the end of each stage you know exactly what you've got. No hidden costs, no open-ended timelines.
process.p1: We review your business, website, ads and competitors to pinpoint the biggest growth opportunities.
process.p2: Goals, KPIs, budget and a phased roadmap — in writing, in plain language.
process.p3: Websites, campaigns and content are delivered in short sprints, with your sign-off at every step.
process.p4: After launch we test, optimise and scale based on real data.

toolkit.label: Technology and channels
toolkit.heading: The *right* tool for the job.
toolkit.text: We choose technology for results, not trends.

principles.label: Our principles
principles.heading: Transparency is the *foundation*.
principles.p1: Every stage and cost is itemised in the proposal. No surprise invoices.
principles.p2: Not likes — enquiries, sales and cost per result.
principles.p3: We stay after launch: maintenance, updates and growth.

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.heading: Have questions?
faq.q1: How long does it take to build a website?
faq.a1: A landing page usually takes 2–3 weeks, a corporate website 4–8 weeks and an online store 6–12 weeks. We confirm the exact timeline in a written plan after our first call.
faq.a2: Pricing depends on scope, features and timeline. Every stage and cost is listed separately in the proposal — no hidden fees.
faq.q3: Can I order just one service?
faq.a3: Absolutely. We regularly run SEO only, Google Ads only or design only, and we're happy to work alongside your in-house team.
faq.q4: When will I see SEO results?
faq.a4: Technical improvements typically show within 4–8 weeks, while sustained organic growth usually takes 3–6 months. You get a rankings and traffic report every month.
faq.q5: Do you offer support after launch?
faq.a5: Yes. Our monthly support plans cover maintenance, content updates, security and performance monitoring.

cta.p: In a 30-minute intro call we’ll listen to your goals and map out the fastest route to growth together.
